verdict.rationale: Dover's API docs say a full machine-readable specification is downloadable at app.dover.com/docs/api.json, intended for generating clients or feeding AI coding tools. The probe's 404s were on different paths at docs.dover.com, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the api.json URL resolves, explicit statement of the spec format (e.g., OpenAPI version)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The full machine-readable specification is available at [app.dover.com/docs/api.json](https://app.dover.com/docs/api.json). Use it to generate a client or to give an AI coding tool the exact endpoints and fields.
